# Task 10 fixture

Synthetic, token-free plugin and skill authored for VibeWindow under the repository MIT license. Tests install unchanged bytes into real temporary marketplace roots.

- `plugin.json`: frozen legacy `RawPluginManifest.skills` declaration.
- `SKILL.md`: standard frontmatter and `$ARGUMENTS`; a relative resource/script instruction is resolved from the actual skill directory, never the workspace.
- Invocation targets use `<plugin-id>:<skill>`; marketplace IDs retain `<name>@<marketplace>`. Exact `[@label](plugin://id)` selection disambiguates an explicitly named skill without preloading every body, and follows frozen `collect_explicit_plugin_ids` in `codex-rs/core/src/plugins/mentions.rs`; `$` plugin links grant no plugin selection.
- Optional `agents/openai.yaml` product metadata is task 12; missing host tools remain execution failures rather than a claim that loading the instructions executed their workflow.
